Part of TerraFluent.Chart.Reporting. permalink: /chart/types/spline/ doc_section: Chart Reporting doc_section_url: /chart/ generated_by: scripts/split_showcase.py --- {% capture specimen %} {% endcapture %} {% capture snippet %}{% highlight csharp %}{% raw %} string svg = ChartBuilder.Create() .Title("Temperature Trends — Smooth Spline") .Size(700, 400) .XAxis("Week", "W1","W2","W3","W4","W5","W6","W7","W8") .YAxis("Temperature (°C)") .AsAnimated() .Series(s => s .AddSpline("London", new double[] { 18, 20, 22, 25, 27, 24, 21, 19 }, cfg => cfg.Color(ChartColor.ChartBlue)) .AddSpline("Madrid", new double[] { 28, 31, 34, 38, 40, 37, 33, 30 }, cfg => cfg.Color(ChartColor.ChartOrange))) .RenderToSvg(); {% endraw %}{% endhighlight %}{% endcapture %} {% include chart-type-page.html slug=page.type_slug specimen=specimen snippet=snippet %}
